lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized 2D array of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in five primary horizontal rows posterior to the fifth branchial slit, maintaining a consistent inter-blob spatial frequency across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that traverse the horizontal rows, where the high-luminance blobs act as geometric anchor nodes at the intersection points, forming a regular grid-like topology.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient where the dorsal-facing pixels are highly illuminated and the ventral-facing pixels are in deep shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A non-uniform distribution of approximately 12-16 discrete high-luminance blobs within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with a higher spatial density observed along the anterior leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated high-luminance biological object (remora) trailing near the posterior ventral margin of the right pectoral fin.
